title: German Pancake
description: A massive, fluffy, oven-baked pancake that is incredibly easy to make and perfect for sharing.
steps: Place the butter in a baking dish and put it in the preheated oven to melt.
In a blender, combine the eggs, a pinch of salt, and the milk. Blend until well combined.
Carefully remove the baking dish with the melted butter from the oven.
Pour the egg mixture into the baking dish with the hot butter.
Place the dish back into the oven and bake for 20 minutes.
notes:
Serve with fruit or powdered sugar if desired.
